verdict.rationale: There is no documented shared team workspace built from docs and repos. The closest evidence is agent skills, which load reusable instructions from the repo and so can be committed and shared by a team. Session share links and a centralized enterprise config add some team-level sharing, but neither creates a common knowledge source. Missing for 10: a way to build a workspace from docs and repos, a shared team knowledge base, team membership and access controls for such a workspace, and any independent corroboration.
